description: All-mountain snowboard comparison — 261 products across multiple brands, scored on performance, value, geometry, and rider-preference dimensions.

active.description: Criterion participates in the ranking with its (positive) weight. Weight is relative — all active weights are normalized to sum to 1 before use.

dormant.description: Unexplored preference — criterion participates in hybrid Monte Carlo sampling with uniform Dirichlet weight allocation. Generates clarifying questions when it differentiates competitive alternatives. Activated at runtime via set_target or set_weight transform.

excluded.description: User explicitly does not care about this criterion (DON'T CARE). Dropped from the ranking, hybrid sampling, and question generation. Set at runtime via set_state; reactivatable via set_weight(weight=0.05).

criteria.name: price
criteria.description: Retail price in AUD. Lower price represents better value for money, all else being equal.

criteria.name: core_material
criteria.description: Core material quality score. Higher scores indicate premium wood cores with advanced reinforcements (carbon, kevlar) that improve pop, dampening, and durability.

criteria.name: availability
criteria.description: Current market availability score. Higher means easier to purchase right now — in stock at multiple retailers.

criteria.name: warranty
criteria.description: Manufacturer warranty duration in years. Longer warranty indicates manufacturer confidence in durability and provides better buyer protection.

criteria.name: reviewer_opinion
criteria.description: Aggregate reviewer sentiment score. Higher indicates more positive expert and user reviews, reflecting overall satisfaction and recommendation strength.

criteria.name: board_weight
criteria.description: Board weight in grams. Lighter boards are easier to manoeuvre in the air, less fatiguing on long days, and more responsive. Heavier boards can offer more stability at speed.

criteria.name: carving
criteria.description: Carving performance rating on groomed runs. Higher scores indicate better edge-to-edge transitions, grip through carved turns, and precision on hardpack.

criteria.name: powder
criteria.description: Powder performance rating on a 1–10 scale. Higher scores indicate better float, nose lift, and manoeuvrability in deep snow conditions.

criteria.name: edge_hold
criteria.description: Edge hold performance on ice and hardpack. Higher scores mean the board grips better on firm snow, reducing skid-out risk in icy conditions.

criteria.name: chatter_performance
criteria.description: Chatter dampening at speed. Higher scores indicate the board remains stable and composed at high speed without vibration or unpredictable behaviour.

criteria.name: positive_aspect
criteria.description: Strength of positive attributes identified in reviews. Higher scores indicate more standout qualities — exceptional pop, responsiveness, build quality, or unique ride feel.

criteria.name: negative_aspect
criteria.description: Severity of negative attributes identified in reviews. Lower scores (fewer/milder negatives) are better. High scores indicate significant drawbacks like poor durability or narrow use case.

criteria.name: return_policy
criteria.description: Return policy quality score. Higher scores indicate more generous return windows, fewer restocking fees, and easier exchange processes.

criteria.name: jibbing
criteria.description: Jibbing and rail performance rating. Higher scores indicate better press-ability, butter-ability, and forgiveness on rails and boxes in the terrain park.

criteria.name: overall_rating
criteria.description: Overall rating from SnowboardingProfiles on a 0–100 scale. A holistic assessment of the board's quality, performance, and value across all conditions.

criteria.name: speed
criteria.description: Speed and stability rating from TGR reviews. Higher scores indicate better high-speed composure, base glide, and confidence when charging.

criteria.name: jumps
criteria.description: Jump performance rating from TGR reviews. Higher scores indicate better pop, air stability, and landing forgiveness for freestyle jumping.

criteria.name: pipe
criteria.description: Halfpipe performance rating from TGR reviews. Higher scores indicate better wall-to-wall transitions, edge hold on vert, and air control in pipe riding.

criteria.name: flex_rating
criteria.description: Flex stiffness on a 1–10 scale. Softer flex (lower) is more playful and forgiving; stiffer (higher) provides stability at speed and in variable snow.

criteria.name: sidecut_radius
criteria.description: Sidecut radius in metres. Smaller radius enables tighter, quicker turns; larger radius provides stability and flow in wide arcs at speed.

criteria.name: sidecut_radius_159
criteria.description: Sidecut radius normalised to a 159 cm reference size, in metres. Enables apples-to-apples comparison of turn radius characteristics across different board lengths.

criteria.name: effective_edge
criteria.description: Effective edge length in cm — the portion of the edge in contact with snow during a turn. Longer effective edge provides more hold and stability; shorter is more manoeuvrable.

criteria.name: waist_width
criteria.description: Waist width at 156 cm reference size in cm. Must match boot size — too narrow causes toe/heel drag; too wide reduces edge-to-edge responsiveness.

criteria.name: setback
criteria.description: Stance setback in mm. Positive setback shifts weight toward the tail for directional float in powder; zero or negative indicates a centred twin stance for switch riding.

criteria.name: taper
criteria.description: Nose-to-tail width taper in mm. More taper creates a surf-like powder feel and directional float; zero taper indicates symmetric twin geometry.

criteria.name: stance_width
criteria.description: Stance width in cm. Wider stance increases stability and leverage; narrower stance improves agility and is more comfortable for shorter riders.

criteria.name: contact_length
criteria.description: Snow contact length in cm — the running length of base touching snow. Longer contact provides more stability and float; shorter is more playful and loose.

criteria.name: tip_tail_width
criteria.description: Tip and tail width in cm. Wider tips/tails provide more float in powder and stability; narrower allows quicker edge engagement.

criteria.name: tip_tail_width_159
criteria.description: Tip/tail width normalised to 159 cm reference size in cm. Enables fair comparison of tip/tail dimensions across different board lengths.

criteria.name: recommended_weight_range
criteria.description: Recommended rider weight in kg. The board performs optimally within this range — too light and it won't flex properly; too heavy and it loses responsiveness.

criteria.name: recommended_weight_159
criteria.description: Recommended rider weight for the 159 cm size in kg. Normalised reference point for comparing weight recommendations across the dataset.

criteria.name: turn_initiation
criteria.description: Turn initiation speed on a 1–10 scale. Lower values indicate quicker, easier turn entry (more responsive); higher values mean the board requires more input to engage a turn.

criteria.name: camber_profile
criteria.description: Camber profile preference score. Pre-scored [0,1] representing how well the board's camber type matches a rider's preferred profile (rocker, camber, hybrid, flat, etc.).

criteria.name: terrain_suitability
criteria.description: Terrain suitability match on a 1–10 scale. Higher scores indicate the board is better suited to the rider's preferred terrain (groomed, powder, park, backcountry, all-mountain).

criteria.name: on_snow_feel
criteria.description: On-snow feel preference score from TGR reviews. Pre-scored [0,1] representing how well the board's ride character matches the rider's preferred feel (playful, damp, surfy, snappy, etc.).

criteria.name: board_category
criteria.description: Board category match score. Pre-scored [0,1] representing how well the board's category (all-mountain, freeride, freestyle, powder) aligns with the rider's intended use.

templates.price: How important is staying within budget? (1 = money is no object, 10 = cheapest board that works)
templates.core_material: How much do you value premium core materials and construction? (1 = don't care, 10 = only the best cores)
templates.availability: How important is being able to buy the board right now? (1 = happy to wait/preorder, 10 = need it immediately)
templates.warranty: How important is a long manufacturer warranty? (1 = not a factor, 10 = essential for peace of mind)
templates.reviewer_opinion: How much do expert reviews influence your decision? (1 = I trust my own feel, 10 = reviews are everything)
templates.board_weight: How important is a lightweight board to you? (1 = don't notice weight, 10 = every gram counts)
templates.carving: How important is carving performance on groomers? (1 = rarely carve, 10 = live for carving)
templates.powder: How important is powder performance? (1 = mostly ride groomers, 10 = chase every powder day)
templates.edge_hold: How important is edge hold on ice and hardpack? (1 = mostly ride soft snow, 10 = need grip on ice)
templates.chatter_performance: How important is stability and dampening at high speed? (1 = cruise mellow, 10 = charge hard)
templates.positive_aspect: How much do standout positive qualities matter vs. being well-rounded? (1 = prefer balanced, 10 = want exceptional strengths)
templates.negative_aspect: How much do known drawbacks concern you? (1 = can live with trade-offs, 10 = want zero compromises)
templates.return_policy: How important is a generous return policy? (1 = not a factor, 10 = must be able to return easily)
templates.jibbing: How important is jibbing and rail performance? (1 = never hit rails, 10 = park rat life)
templates.overall_rating: How much weight do you put on overall review scores? (1 = just one data point, 10 = trust the aggregate)
templates.speed: How important is high-speed performance and base glide? (1 = mellow cruiser, 10 = speed is life)
templates.jumps: How important is jump and air performance? (1 = stay grounded, 10 = always in the air)
templates.pipe: How important is halfpipe performance? (1 = never ride pipe, 10 = pipe is my main discipline)
templates.flex_rating: What flex do you prefer? (1 = super soft/playful, 10 = stiff/aggressive)

templates.recommended_weight_159: What is your weight? This helps match the 159 cm size recommendation to you.
templates.turn_initiation: Do you prefer quick effortless turn entry or a board that requires deliberate input? (1 = instant/easy, 10 = deliberate/powerful)
templates.camber_profile: What camber profile do you prefer? (rocker = playful/forgiving, camber = precise/poppy, hybrid = balanced)
templates.terrain_suitability: What terrain do you ride most? (groomed, powder, park, backcountry, all-mountain mix)
